设计意图： A price-level repricing is only genuine if, after breaking the prior 20-day high, the stock persistently closes in the upper quartile of the post-breakout channel rather than fading back to the broken level. This crossover combines the persistent upper-quartile close mechanism from C1201 with the breakout-efficiency/volume mechanism from C303: the post-breakout hold-persistence count conditions th

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 atr：alpha_tools.average_true_range(df_copy, window=14)
  2. 计算 resistance：high.滚动窗口(20).max().shift(1)
  3. 计算 channel_high：high.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=5).max()
  4. 计算 channel_range：(channel_high - resistance)
  5. 计算 hold_loc：(close - resistance) / channel_range
  6. 计算 hold_flag：((hold_loc >= 0.75) & (close > resistance)).astype(float)
  7. 计算 hold_persistence：hold_flag.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=5).sum() / 10.0
  8. 计算 position：((close - resistance) / atr).clip(0.0, 5.0)
  9. 计算 efficiency：alpha_tools.directional_efficiency(df_copy, window=10)
  10. 计算 vol_conf：alpha_tools.volume_momentum_ratio(volume, long_window=20, short_window=5).clip(0.5, 2.0)
  11. 计算 factor：position * hold_persistence * (0.5 + 0.5 * efficiency.clip(-1.0, 1.0)) * vol_conf
  12. 计算 factor：factor
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

volume成交量基础行情字段

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_breakout_hold_persistence_20d(df): "str">''' Idea: A genuine level repricing is confirmed when, after breaking the prior 20-day high, the stock persistently closes "kw">class="kw">in the upper quartile of the post-breakout channel instead of fading back toward the broken level. Logic: The prior 20-day high acts as the new floor. The 10-day persistence of closes "kw">class="kw">in the upper quartile of the post-breakout channel captures the buying-pressure mechanism "kw">class="kw">from the persistent-upper-quartile parent, "kw">class="kw">while the ATR-normalized distance above the broken level, directional efficiency, "kw">class="kw">and volume momentum retain the breakout-decisiveness mechanism "kw">class="kw">from the efficiency parent. Persistent holds above the level receive high positive values; failed attempts that close back below resistance collapse to zero. Sub-mechanism tags: post-breakout-hold, upper-quartile-persistence, directional-efficiency, volume-confirmation Formula: hold_persistence * (close-prior_high)/ATR * (0.5+0.5*efficiency) * volume_momentum "str">''' df_copy = df.copy() atr = alpha_tools.average_true_range(df_copy, window=14).replace(0.0, np.nan) resistance = df_copy["str">'high'].rolling(20).max().shift(1) channel_high = df_copy["str">'high'].rolling(10, min_periods=5).max() channel_range = (channel_high - resistance).replace(0.0, np.nan) hold_loc = (df_copy["str">'close'] - resistance) / channel_range hold_flag = ((hold_loc >= 0.75) & (df_copy["str">'close'] > resistance)).astype(float) hold_persistence = hold_flag.rolling(10, min_periods=5).sum() / 10.0 position = ((df_copy["str">'close'] - resistance) / atr).clip(0.0, 5.0) efficiency = alpha_tools.directional_efficiency(df_copy, window=10) vol_conf = alpha_tools.volume_momentum_ratio(df_copy["str">'volume'], long_window=20, short_window=5).clip(0.5, 2.0) factor = position * hold_persistence * (0.5 + 0.5 * efficiency.clip(-1.0, 1.0)) * vol_conf factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_breakout_hold_persistence_20d'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_breakout_hold_persistence_20d']
